home.layout: Masthead with lab name and university crest, single-paragraph mission, three highlighted publication cards in a row, two PhD opening callouts, news ticker list, group photo, funder logo strip.

research.layout: Sectioned long-form page with four thematic research areas; each area has a heading, prose description, inline SVG diagram, and a bulleted list of three key papers.

publications.layout: Year-grouped reverse-chronological list with filter chips at top; each entry is a hanging-indent citation with venue badge and link row (PDF, arXiv, Code, Data).

people.layout: Role-grouped roster: PI featured large at top, then grid sections for PhD Students, Postdocs, Research Scientists, and an Alumni table with placement column.

join.layout: Two-column prose-heavy page with PhD application info on left and FAQ accordion on right, followed by open positions list and visiting researcher callout box.
